ai_summary_zh: 本場區包含鋪面道路與人行步道，總面積約1912.8平方公尺，路面狀況良好。場區內植栽包含一株胸徑約30.8公分的喬木，並設有總面積約145.7平方公尺的擋土牆或建築牆體。經現場勘查，本場區無水域。
ai_summary_en: The site features paved roads and walkways covering approximately 1912.8 square meters in good condition. It includes one urban tree with a mean DBH of 30.8 cm at 1.3m height and 145.7 square meters of retaining or building wall structures. There are no water bodies present on the site.
